package.description: Connect patients with local community services

en-US.description: Connect patients with local community services
en-US.longDescription: JoyConnect Universal is a desktop tool that helps you easily connect patients with non-clinical care by referring them to local community services. It runs as a small widget on your screen and signs in with your Microsoft account.
en-US.name: JoyConnect Universal

zh-CN.description: 帮助患者连接本地社区服务
zh-CN.longDescription: JoyConnect Universal 是一款桌面工具，通过转介本地社区服务，帮助您轻松地将患者与非临床照护连接起来。它以屏幕上的小部件形式运行，并使用您的 Microsoft 账户登录。
